applies_to: Public & private organizations (QFC has separate rules)
key_requirements: Consent or legitimate purpose, data subject rights, breach notification, permit for special-nature data
enforcement_authority: National Cyber Governance and Assurance Affairs within the National Cyber Security Agency (NCSA)
exemptions: Personal or family use; official statistics
research_exemption: Processing for statistical and research purposes listed among exemptions (article not confirmed); art. 18 exempts government processing for security/public interest (unconfirmed)
genetic_data: No specific genetic rule; special-nature data (art. 16: race, health, physical/psychological condition, etc.) needs permit; Minister may add categories
notes: Law No. 13 of 2016; compliance period extended to 29 Jan 2018; QFC has own regime
